messages:
riley: Kicking off SilverSun joint perf pass. They want a tight reproducible perf/W protocol + kernel tuning recipe for marketplace. @nina @oscar can you propose a minimal sweep?
nina: Minimal sweep: model=llama-7b, seqs=1024/2048, powercaps=90/130/170W, quants=q4_0 and q8_0. Metrics: p50/p95/p99, throughput_tps, avg_power_w sampled @5Hz. Export CSV per run.
oscar: Kernel knobs: isolcpus=4-11 nohz_full=4-11 rcu_nocbs=4-11. Example run: `./bench.sh --model llama-7b --seq 2048 --batch 4 --quant q4_0 --powercap 130 --out s3://redwood-bench/silversun/1819999999/`
riley: Partner wants acceptance criteria: perf/W >= baseline+10% at 130W OR p99 < 240ms at seq=2048. Also a one-pager and raw CSVs.
nina: Telemetry ingest: https://telemetry.redwood.dev/ingest (X-API-KEY). Schema: ["timestamp","device_id","power_w","gpu_util","p99_ms","throughput_tps","joules_per_token"]. Will add Grafana dashboards.
oscar: Dataset: 600 prompts staged at /data/bench/silversun/600.jsonl.gz. I'll smoke tonight.
bench-bot: JIRA INF-11011 created (assignee=@oscar). Tag experiments: "silversun-2026-q1". Runbook template attached.
riley: Action items: Nina -> telemetry + runbook; Oscar -> kernel patches + smoke + artifacts; I'll draft partner one-pager and schedule Wed sync 10am PT. Proceed if smoke passes.
nina: Ack. Will push runbook link and CSV header example.
oscar: Ack. Smoke tonight and upload artifacts to s3.
riley: :thumbsup: Thanks team. Looping SilverSun after smoke.
